observations: Single compact audio/mini hi-fi stack unit visible, sitting on bare floor against a worn sofa.
Dual cassette deck (A/B) visible at bottom, CD/tuner section in middle, top section has small buttons.
Heavy dust and grime coating the entire unit, especially cassette door and dial.
No speakers, remote, or power adapter visible in the photo.
A loose paper/tag is wedged in one cassette door.
Unit shows no visible physical damage (no cracks, no missing panels) but condition is dirty/aged.

identity.kind: compact/mini hi-fi audio system (receiver unit with CD and dual cassette)

claims.claim: Currently not functioning, sold as scrap for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: No power-on test possible from a static photo; seller's own text asserts this directly.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, no dead key, no crackle
claims.evidence: Directly contradicts the seller's own description stating the unit is 'not functioning' and sold as scrap; photo 0 shows no power-on state to confirm either claim.
No origin markings, voltage plate, or UK plug visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on at all despite being plugged in
risks.proof: Video clip of unit powered on, display lit, disc tray and cassette doors operating

risks.risk: No speakers included, only the main stack unit
risks.proof: Photo showing matching speaker pair alongside the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as head-unit only, no speakers

risks.risk: Contradiction between 'scrap/not functioning' and 'all keys working' claims suggests copy-paste or misleading listing text
risks.proof: A clear seller statement or video resolving which description is accurate
risks.if_unproven: priced at the worse of the two claims (non-functioning)

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or belt/mechanism failure in cassette decks and CD changer, common in aged UK-import units stored in humid conditions
risks.proof: Video of disc tray ejecting and cassette playing audio

risks.risk: No adapter/power cable visible despite claim
risks.proof: Photo of the actual power adapter/cable with the unit

proof_requests: Video of the unit plugged in and powered on, showing display, disc tray, and cassette operation
Photo of the power adapter/cable claimed to be included
Photo of any accompanying speakers, if being sold together
Close-up photo of rear panel (ports, serial/voltage plate) to confirm UK origin and check for damage
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a MINISTAR-branded compact audio system (CD/dual-cassette stack) from photo 0, but the seller's own description contradicts itself, claiming both 'not functioning/scrap' and 'all keys working with no issues'; no power-on proof exists, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-functioning scrap unit with no speakers or confirmed adapter.
